A family lawyer has two current clients: a Native American man and a Native American woman. The Native American man lost custody of their kids to the state due to issues with alcohol, while the Native American woman got joint custody of their kids due to a steady job and sobriety. Who was sober and had a steady job?
A. The Native American man
B. Not known
C. The Native American woman
